note: Words from the Duolingo units that never had a picture, plus the ones whose picture was filed under an alternate gloss the app never looks up — those had a photograph nobody ever saw, and this puts one under the gloss the course actually teaches. Function words, pronouns and conjugated verbs are left out on purpose: no picture says 'whose' or 'they will apologize'.
